data.name: Talay Marsa
overview: Talay by Aldar introduces the first luxury residential address at Marsa Al Saadiyat, bringing together two distinct collections of standalone villas: **Talay and Talay Beach Villas**. Together, the gated communities offer **351 exclusive 4–6 bedroom villas**, designed for families seeking generous space, privacy and a refined coastal lifestyle. Talay comprises 167 villas, while Talay Beach offers 184, and both collections feature spacious layouts and private outdoor spaces.

The opportunity extends beyond the homes themselves. Set within Marsa Al Saadiyat, the community combines beachside living, landscaped spaces and family-focused amenities with Emirati-inspired design. Traditional elements such as the **Outdoor Majlis Pavilion, Aflaj Water Feature and Areesh-inspired details** create a distinctive sense of place, while beach access, wellness facilities and recreational spaces support everyday family living.

highlights.title: First Luxury Address at Marsa Al Saadiyat
highlights.text: Talay introduces the first luxury residential address at Marsa Al Saadiyat, giving buyers an opportunity to secure a home within the destination’s first residential offering.

highlights.title: 351 Standalone Villas
highlights.text: Two gated communities offer 351 exclusive 4–6 bedroom villas, comprising 167 Talay villas and 184 Talay Beach Villas.

highlights.title: Two Distinct Villa Collections
highlights.text: Talay and Talay Beach Villas offer two collections of spacious standalone homes, including dedicated beach villas, designed around family living and coastal experiences.

highlights.title: A Connected Waterfront Destination
highlights.text: Marsa Al Saadiyat offers access to 8 km of coastline, 5.6 km of beaches, a 1 km promenade, 140 km of walking paths and a 46 km cycling loop.

highlights.title: Emirati Heritage Reimagined
highlights.text: A landscaped green spine features falaj-inspired water channels, an Outdoor Majlis Pavilion, family amenities and direct beach access, bringing traditional influences into contemporary community design.

highlights.title: Bespoke Artistic Elements
highlights.text: The community incorporates artistic elements created in collaboration with Emirati artist Abdalla Almulla, including a commissioned fountain.

highlights.title: Spacious Family Homes
highlights.text: Talay villas range from 502 sqm to 630 sqm GSA, while Talay Beach Villas range from 506 sqm to 634 sqm GSA, with layouts designed around family living.

highlights.title: Aldar Development
highlights.text: Developed by Aldar, Talay forms part of Marsa Al Saadiyat, a major waterfront destination connected to the Saadiyat Cultural District.

highlights.title: A Major Saadiyat Destination
highlights.text: Marsa Al Saadiyat spans approximately 6.4 million sqm and is planned to accommodate 58,000+ residents, alongside Abu Dhabi’s largest marina and direct connectivity to the Saadiyat Cultural District.

highlights.title: 50/50 Payment Plan
highlights.text: Talay follows a 50/50 payment structure, with 50% payable through the scheduled pre-handover instalments and 50% at handover.

data.amenitiesIntro: Talay Marsa offers an exceptional array of world-class amenities designed to enhance every aspect of modern living.
data.paymentNote: Talay starts from AED 13.5M for 4-bedroom villas with a 50/50 payment plan.
locationText: Talay Marsa Al Saadiyat places residents within one of Abu Dhabi’s emerging waterfront destinations, combining coastal living with access to culture, education and community facilities. The Saadiyat Cultural District’s major cultural and creative destinations are approximately five minutes from Marsa Al Saadiyat, while Talay itself is planned with a school, mosque, beach club, marina and future apartments within the wider community.
data.investmentIntro: This off-plan project presents strong investment potential across the UAE, with projected rental yields of 6–8%, long-term capital appreciation, and growing demand from both residents and international investors.
marketContext: UAE off-plan properties continue to attract strong local and international investor demand.
Selected communities may offer rental yields of around 6–8%, depending on location and unit type.
Buyers may benefit from 10–15% potential price growth by handover in high-demand areas.
Properties from AED 2 million may qualify for UAE Golden Visa eligibility, subject to regulations.

faqs.question: What is Talay by Aldar?
faqs.answer: Talay by Aldar is the first luxury residential address at Marsa Al Saadiyat, comprising two gated villa communities with 351 standalone 4–6 bedroom villas.

faqs.question: Where is Talay located?
faqs.answer: Talay is located within Marsa Al Saadiyat on Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi, with the Saadiyat Cultural District approximately five minutes away.

faqs.question: Who is the developer of Talay?
How much is Talay?
faqs.answer: Talay prices start from AED 13.5M for 4-bedroom villas, with 5-bedroom villas starting from AED 15.5M and 6-bedroom villas from AED 17.2M.

faqs.question: What is the Talay payment plan?
faqs.answer: The Talay payment plan is 50/50, with scheduled instalments before handover and 50% payable at handover.

faqs.question: What is the Talay handover date?
faqs.answer: The estimated Talay handover date is Q4 2029. Talay Beach is scheduled for Q4 2030.

faqs.question: What villa types are available at Talay?
What are the Talay villa sizes?
faqs.answer: Talay villas range from 502 sqm to 630 sqm GSA, while Talay Beach villas range from 506 sqm to 634 sqm GSA.

faqs.question: What amenities are available at Talay?
faqs.answer: Talay amenities include landscaped green spaces, beach access, community and kids’ pools, padel courts, fitness facilities, cycling loops, jogging tracks, picnic areas, a pet park, EV charging stations, an Outdoor Majlis Pavilion and an Aflaj Water Feature.

faqs.question: What makes Talay different?
faqs.answer: Talay combines a limited collection of standalone villas with a waterfront setting, family-focused amenities and Emirati-inspired design elements, including the Outdoor Majlis Pavilion, Aflaj Water Feature and Areesh-inspired architecture.

faqs.question: Is Talay an off-plan project?
faqs.answer: Talay is a new residential development with an estimated Q4 2029 handover, making it an opportunity to secure a villa before completion.

faqs.question: How can I buy a Talay villa?
faqs.answer: Buyers interested in Talay villas for sale can review the available 4-, 5-, and 6-bedroom configurations and contact property experts for information on availability and purchase procedures.
